description: Prototype side (reference data): update data.js/store.js and four small UI lines so the prototype agrees with the planned seed. Covers plan2.md decisions D1-UI, D2, D3 (joined dates), D4 a-e, D5 (OTHER_DOJO_CLASSES into SESSIONS only), D8 (DB_KEY v4). Independent of FEAT-002 except that FEAT-002 copies the values chosen here; read plan2.md first.
steps: Read .db-tmp/plan2.md fully, then src/public/js/data.js, store.js and the files named in the steps.
data.js CLASSES: change the Sunday 11:00 Weapons row (day 6) instructor to 'Pang Kim Lock Sensei'.

data.js: add const OTHER_DOJO_CLASSES (20 SAMPLE rows from the plan2.md D5 table, fields dojo/day/time/type/ins/cap/booked and kids:true for Children types) right after CLASSES with a comment that they are sample data and are NOT bookable online. Do not add them to CLASSES.

data.js SEED(): add a lastDow(dow, weeksBack) helper (most recent date strictly before TODAY with that weekday, Monday=0); build const SES = [...CLASSES, ...OTHER_DOJO_CLASSES].map((c, i) => ({ ...c, code: sessionCode(c.dojo, c.day, c.time, (4821 + i * 137) % 9000 + 1000) })) and use sessions: SES. Keep the SEED() return shape.

data.js members: add joinedAt (ISO) to the 10 members with the plan2.md D3 dates; Marcus Lim joined 'Sep 2026' with joinedAt 2026-09-14; remove the '14 Jun 2025' pays row (INV-2042803); ledger L(6) Hannah Teo grading fee amount 50 and date ear(2, 12); gradingFeedback[0].date = new Date(2026, 2, 15).

data.js attendance: replace the 7 rows by the 6 rows in plan2.md D4c (newest first) using lastDow; point levelUps[0].date at the newest present row; re-key the Lervyn class/student/grading remarks (daysAgo(3)|19:00 -> Mon 2 Nov slot, daysAgo(6)|19:00 -> Fri 30 Oct slot) with lastDow so remarksForStudent still matches attended slots.

Create .db-tmp/feedback-map.json: for each of the 12 feedback rows (same order) pick the nearest earlier real HQ slot taught by Bob Tan Sensei of the same type (Adults Mon/Wed/Fri 19:00, Intermediate Mon 20:00, Mixed Sat 11:00, Advanced Thu 20:00), record {index, dow, weeksBack, lesson_id}. First grep instructor.js (myFeedback and period filters) and keep the existing spread of about 36 days. Apply the dates in data.js feedback with lastDow.

data.js closures: keep C-01; add C-02 {scope:'HQ', from/to new Date(2026,11,13), note:'Grading day: Sunday classes paused'}; add C-03 class cancel {scope:'class', code: SES Tue 19:00 Adults code, from: lastDow(1), to same, label:'Adults 7 PM', note, students:N, lessons:N} where N is the number of rows for LS-20261103-1900-HQ-A in the seed (count after FEAT-002 loads the seed; use 3 as a placeholder only if FEAT-002 has not run and record that in findings). Move sentLog[0].at to the same date.

store.js: bump DB_KEY to 'ask-prototype-v4' (comment: closures, other-dojo sessions, weekday-aligned attendance, joined dates); add const hqClosedOn = date => (DB.closures || []).find(c => c.scope === 'HQ' && isoDate(new Date(c.from)) <= isoDate(new Date(date)) && isoDate(new Date(date)) <= isoDate(new Date(c.to))) after the DB block (do NOT name it closureOn: admin-shell.js declares that); set joinedAgo for Chloe, Sophia, Tan Siew Eng, Ivan Teo, Natalie, Faisal, Olivia, Benjamin, Lakshmi to the day count from the D3 date to 2026-11-06 (compute with node).

instructor.js: myClasses returns [] when hqClosedOn(d). student.js slotInfo: add `else if (hqClosedOn(dt)) { cls.push('full', 'nope'); sub = 'HQ closed'; }` after the whyNot branch. admin-desk.js line ~402: grading fee keyed by the next rank (GRADING_FEE[(BELTS[BELTS.findIndex(b => b.g === (m && m.g)) + 1] || {}).g] || 60).

Write .db-tmp/serve.mjs (node http static server for src/public on a free port) and .db-tmp/browser-check.mjs (playwright-core installed in %TEMP%\askpw; Edge headless; 1280 and 390 widths; loads every html under student_portal, instructor_portal, admin_portal (sign-in via the same sessionStorage keys the portal uses, see portal.js/signin pages), landingpage; records console errors and failed requests; screenshots to .db-tmp/screens/). Stop the server when done.
Record in findings: every edit to data.js/store.js/student.js/instructor.js/admin-desk.js, the feedback map, and the N used for the closure.
acceptance_criteria: CLASSES Sunday 11:00 Weapons is taught by Pang Kim Lock Sensei and no examiner of the 13 Dec panel (Bob Tan, Steven Goh, Robin Tan) has a Sunday class.
SEED().sessions has 39 rows (19 HQ + 20 non-HQ) with unique codes, HQ codes unchanged, and CLASSES still has 19 HQ rows only.
Student, instructor and admin pages load at 1280px and 390px with no console errors and no 404s.
Admin Classes > rosters shows 13 Dec and 3 Nov 19:00 Adults as Cancelled; instructor schedule on 13 Dec shows no group classes but still shows the grading panel for examiners.
Admin Classes timetable lists the 20 sample non-HQ sessions with 'No, HQ only' for online booking; student book page and landing HQ timetable show HQ classes only.
Lervyn's attendance rows all fall on real timetable weekdays/times with the correct instructor.
verification: Serve src/public and run node .db-tmp/browser-check.mjs: 0 console errors, 0 failed requests at 1280px and 390px for all portal pages
Inspect screenshots in .db-tmp/screens/ (student home/book/grading, instructor schedule, admin Today and Classes)
node -e load check: evaluating data.js SEED() with a stubbed document does not throw (the agreement script in FEAT-002 repeats this)
findings: data.js: (1) CLASSES Sun 11:00 Weapons ins -> Pang Kim Lock Sensei. (2) new const OTHER_DOJO_CLASSES (20 SAMPLE rows, D5 table, kids:true on Children types) after CLASSES. (3) SEED(): added lastDow(dow, weeksBack) and SES = [...CLASSES, ...OTHER_DOJO_CLASSES] with sessionCode; sessions: SES. (4) members: joinedAt on all 10 (D3 dates); Marcus joined 'Sep 2026' / 2026-09-14. (5) pays: removed INV-2042803 (14 Jun 2025). (6) ledger L(6) Hannah grading fee 50, ear(2, 12). (7) gradingFeedback[0].date = 15 Mar 2026. (8) attendance replaced by 6 rows via lastDow (Wed4 Nov, Mon2, Sat31 11:00 Mixed, Fri30, Thu29 Steven Goh noshow, Wed28); levelUps[0].date = lastDow(2); Lervyn class/student remark keys re-keyed to lastDow(0) (Mon 2 Nov) and class/grading to lastDow(4) (Fri 30 Oct). (9) feedback dates re-set with lastDow per .db-tmp/feedback-map.json. (10) closures: kept C-01, added C-02 HQ 13 Dec 2026 'Grading day: Sunday classes paused', C-03 class cancel (code = SES HQ Tue 19:00 Adults, from/to lastDow(1), label 'Adults 7 PM', note 'Class cancelled by the dojo', students:5, lessons:5). (11) sentLog[0].at = lastDow(1). store.js: DB_KEY -> 'ask-prototype-v4' with comment; added hqClosedOn(date) before save(); joinedAgo set to Chloe 472, Sophia 871, Tan Siew Eng 1151, Ivan 1578, Natalie 794, Faisal 626, Olivia 423, Benjamin 977, Lakshmi 1235 (days to 2026-11-06). instructor.js: myClasses returns [] when hqClosedOn(d). student.js slotInfo: added hqClosedOn branch ('HQ closed'). admin-desk.js ~402: grading fee keyed by next rank. Feedback map: .db-tmp/feedback-map.json (12 rows; row 8 is Sat 3 Oct instead of 10 Oct because HQ has no sessions 10-11 Oct; lesson ids all LS-YYYYMMDD-HHMM-HQ-A). Closure N = 5 (measured on the current seed.sql via PGlite: 5 class_attendance rows for LS-20261103-1900-HQ-A; FEAT-002 had not run yet, so FEAT-002 must re-check the count after its seed changes and update C-03 students/lessons if it differs). Verification: node .db-tmp/browser-check.mjs -> 0 console errors, 0 failed requests, 39 pages x 1280/390 (external logo/font hosts and favicon.ico ignored; instructor grading redirect to index is the expected examiner gate). .db-tmp/accept-check.mjs: 39 sessions (19 HQ), 39 unique codes, HQ-SUN11-8287 unchanged, CLASSES 19, 13 Dec HQ closed, Tue 3 Nov-style class cancel active. Scripts: .db-tmp/serve.mjs, browser-check.mjs, accept-check.mjs; screenshots in .db-tmp/screens/ (real clock was 17 Nov 2026 so pages are not at the 6 Nov anchor). Note: attendance order is newest-first only when today is the anchor weekday pattern; other weekdays reorder rows. Server stopped; playwright-core only in %TEMP%\askpw.
